To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the learning algorithms of RBF networks can be used for fuzzy systems, but the structure of fuzzy systems is changed during the learning process and, therefore, it is important to extract interpretable fuzzy rules after the learning of the RBF network.
Radial basis function (RBF) networks and fuzzy rule system are functionally equivalent, but not structurally equivalent.
the learning algorithms of RBF networks can be used for the parameter adaptation of interpretable fuzzy systems, and that the structure of the fuzzy system is not changed after the learning process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of how to extract interpretable fuzzy rules, from the RBF networks, without losing the accuracy of the network.
the problem that how to preserve interpretability of the original fuzzy rule system when using neural networks to learn the parameters of fuzzy rule systems.
the problem of preserving the structure of an interpretable fuzzy system after the adaptation of the parameters of the system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper presents a method for extracting fuzzy rules from RRF networks.
the proposed method is able to extract interpretable fuzzy systems from RBF networks.
the proposed method is an efficient and practical way to extract interpretable fuzzy rules for RBF networks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we can obtain an interpretable fuzzy rule base from the RBF network, which can approximate the original function well.
we can extract fuzzy rules from R.B.F. networks and keep their interpretability.
we have developed a method to extract fuzzy rules from an RBF network, and the fuzzy rules are interpretable and can be used to describe the behavior of the network.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the RBF network is not an appropriate choice for fuzzy systems, because it lacks the interpretability of fuzzy systems.
it is possible to extract interpretable fuzzy rules directly from the RBF network.
, by applying a post-processing step, it is possible to obtain an interpretable fuzzy system from a trained RBF network.
